test_title: PYST 16: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 8 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

MASTER : AMHGRE :: LUXURY : ULCFYR :: FORMAL : ?
solution:
**The logic followed here is:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af9cfa35a1b8810e38328421bfbd33050c32de331085ef6af8fde345c735089f.png] 

MASTER : AMHGRE

it is coded as alphabet positional value

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23c262814cba8c0e0cfc13e254b0fd29fca6cc7b0f65340e4ef6e6febf5bb22f.png] 

In the same way

LUXURY : ULCFYR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b75d7ffc4c70a2460f3fb29fb8d70b69b129bef105dea3760e3f313e993331b.png] 

Similarly,

FORMAL : OFINLA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90b04bdb3690674cd6bb726f06e30eae7242be02de99d859615fe4d8fd1085ce.png] 

Hence, **OFINLA** is the correct answer.
